Subject: Bespoke bundling & platform fee — NebulaHealth private deployment terms

Hi Priyanka / Andrew —

Following our call this morning, attaching a starter SOW + a pricing workbook that lays out two packaging approaches for VPC/on-prem deployments: one with an amortized platform fee and one with a reduced upfront platform fee plus a usage floor. High-level notes:

- Platform fee: covers control plane, service discovery, and long-term product updates for private deployments.
- Support tiers: Silver (business hours), Gold (24/7 P1 coverage), Platinum (Gold + SRE on-call retainer).
- Starter credits: we can apply a one-time pilot credit to offset the first 3 months of platform fees for pilot nodes.

We understand procurement needs clarity on amortization, invoice cadence, and what can be capitalized. In the workbook you’ll see line items for: platform fee, operator licenses, SRE retainer, and optional on-prem observability add-ons.

Next steps I recommend: you pick the structuring approach you prefer (amortize or upfront with floor), we’ll run numbers, and Ben will propose final commercial language for legal/procurement. If useful we can produce a redline-friendly term sheet for DocuSign.

Attachments: NebulaHealth_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, pricing_model_breakdown.xlsx

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

From: Priyanka Singh <psingh@nebulahealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Andrew Blake <andrew.blake@nebulahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Bespoke bundling & platform fee — NebulaHealth private deployment terms

Thanks Sofia — good summary. A few questions from our side as we prep this for procurement:

1) Can you show a 12-month amortized example where the platform fee is spread monthly and offset by pilot credits?
2) What's the minimum committed throughput / usage floor if we take the reduced upfront platform fee option?
3) Our finance team prefers to capitalize platform fees where possible — can you provide the exact description we should use for capitalization (i.e., product name / license line)?

Also — pricing expectation: we’d like to see if there’s room for a modest discount on the platform fee in year 1 (10–15%) in exchange for a 12–18 month usage commitment. Procurement will also ask for SLA credit details for P1/P2 windows. I’ll loop procurement once we have a small redlineable term sheet.

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Priyanka Singh
VP Product Operations, NebulaHealth
psingh@nebulahealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bespoke bundling & platform fee — NebulaHealth private deployment terms

Hi Priyanka —

Thanks — I pushed a revised pricing sheet and two concrete commercial structures:

Option A — Amortized path (recommended for accounting clarity)
- 12-month amortization of platform fee, billed monthly.
- 15% pilot credit applied across first 3 months (applies before amortization).
- Support: Gold (24/7 P1) included; optional SRE retainer billed separately.
- Commitment: 18-month term with an annual usage review.

Option B — Upfront reduced platform fee + usage floor
- 25% reduced platform fee if NebulaHealth commits to a 12-month minimum usage floor (specified in tokens / nodes).
- If floor is not met, true-up at quarter-end.
- Support: Gold included; Platinum add-on available at fixed monthly fee.

On discounts: we can consider 10–15% year-1 platform fee discount in return for a 12–18 month committed floor — aligns with what you suggested. I included cells in the workbook that calculate effective unit economics under both options.

I’ll pull together a short term sheet (DocuSign-ready) that maps these options to redlineable contract clauses. For procurement, we typically label the platform fee as: "Redwood Private Platform Subscription — Platform & Control Plane License (non-capital service)." If finance needs different wording to facilitate capitalization, we can tweak the invoice description.

Attached: NebulaHealth_SOW_revised_v2.pdf (pricing sections updated)

Best —
Ben Carter
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

1) Year-1 platform fee: request 20% discount off the list platform fee OR the amortized schedule with a 15% discount and a 12-month firm commitment.
2) SLA credits: extend the P1 credit window to 30 days for invoice crediting and ensure P2 credit calculation is clarified.
3) Security acceptance: we need a statement that Redwood will address SOC2 controls requested during due diligence and provide a contact for evidence delivery.
4) Deliverables: list of runbooks and on-call escalation matrices to be delivered at start of pilot.

Hi Priyanka / Procurement team —

Thanks for the clear asks. Summary response and what we can commit to in the term sheet:

1) Discounting / amortization: Redwood can offer the amortized platform fee with a 15% discount on year-1 pricing if NebulaHealth signs a 12-month firm commitment. Alternatively, we will consider a one-time 20% discount if NebulaHealth agrees to a 24-month usage commitment — Ben can surface the exact floor values.

2) SLA crediting: we will confirm P1 credits applied as a billing credit within 30 days of confirmed incident postmortem. We will add explicit language for P2 calculation in the contract appendix.

3) Security evidence: Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II report (if requested), an SSAE crosswalk, and a named point of contact for evidence collection. Attached is our standard security intake package (answers_security_questionnaire.pdf). We will also deliver runbooks and the on-call escalation matrix at pilot kickoff.

4) Next steps: Ben to produce a short DocuSign-ready term sheet that captures the amortization + 15% discount option and the alternative 24-month 20% discount option; legal will then review redlines. Expected timeline: term sheet to you by EOD Monday, PO within 10 business days after legal sign-off.

Please confirm which discount/commitment option you prefer and we’ll finalize the term sheet.

Regards —
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance (on behalf of Redwood Commercial)
irene_choi@redwood.ai
